gemini.title: Scotland Population Age Civil Status Oa
gemini.abstract: Scotland Population Age Civil Status Oa is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It contains records relating to scotland population age civil status oa.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
